target.definition_locator: Planck VI section 2.2.4; component descriptions section 2.2.3

primary_paper.citation: Planck Collaboration, Planck 2018 results. VI. Cosmological parameters, A&A 641, A6 (2020)
primary_paper.result_locator: Table 2, fourth column TT,TE,EE+lowE, 68% intervals; PDF p.15; HTML lines 509-536
primary_paper.equation_disambiguation: Planck VI Eq. (2), section 2.2.3, tau=0.0506 +/- 0.0086 is lowE-only, not the joint Table 2 posterior.
primary_paper.nonmatching_result_warning: Planck VI Table 1 Plik best fit and posterior values use TT,TE,EE+lowE+lensing.

assumptions: adiabatic scalar perturbations with power-law primordial scalar spectrum
three neutrino species: two massless and one massive at 0.06 eV
BBN helium using PArthENoPE 1.1; fixed neutron lifetime 880.2 s; mean Y_P about 0.2454

uniform_priors.source: Planck 2013 XVI Table 1, carried forward by Planck 2018 VI section 2.1
Planck 2013 XVI Table 1, carried forward by Planck 2018 VI section 2.1
Planck 2013 XVI Table 1, carried forward by Planck 2018 VI section 2.1
Planck 2013 XVI Table 1, carried forward by Planck 2018 VI section 2.1
Planck 2013 XVI Table 1, carried forward by Planck 2018 VI section 2.1

additional_hard_prior.source: Planck 2013 XVI section 2; H0 is derived in base LCDM

model_and_priors.uncertainty_caveat: Planck VI says unmodelled likelihood systematics may make about 0.5 sigma a more realistic total systematic uncertainty.

foreground_summary: CIB index -1.3 and TE/EE dust indices -2.4 fixed
TT Galactic-dust and TE dust amplitudes have Gaussian priors
EE dust amplitudes fixed at template central values
nuisance_caveats.sz_coupled_prior: Gaussian prior on ksz_norm + 1.6*A_sz with mean 9.5, standard deviation 3.0
nuisance_caveats.likelihood_structure: hybrid low/high multipole baseline neglects low/high correlations; low-ell TE excluded
nuisance_caveats.warning: Component YAMLs do not set the six cosmological priors; declare them in the later Cobaya input.

initial_point.nuisance_action: Initialize and sample the full pinned Plik nuisance block; published Table 2 does not supply a joint best-fit nuisance vector.

chain_products.allowed_role: posterior comparison and possible initial values after metadata checks
chain_products.not_likelihood_evidence_because: derived posterior samples and GetDist products are not the raw likelihood; they cannot rescore arbitrary parameters, replace clik components, or be added as an independent observation.
chain_products.other_products: Full-grid archives mix combinations; lensing-only chains represent a different observation.

local_artifact.status: already present in shared staging at audit; not fetched, extracted, or modified by this task
local_artifact.meaning: official raw likelihood-data archive, not a scored likelihood

limitations: No chain archive larger than 5 MiB was fetched; exact no-lensing chain contents were not inspected.
The initialization is not the exact maximum-likelihood point.
Cobaya v3.6.2 is a pinned component mapping, not a bit-for-bit recreation of historical CAMB/CosmoMC.
